'''C8-S3C''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] active during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
C8-S3C appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Cartel companion available from the Dread Warlord Pack, added with Patch 5.2.2.
